$comment: Index strings produced by upstream src/custom-index.ts for every index of every upstream fixture schema, including values at and beyond the schema-declared minimum/maximum so the clamping behaviour is pinned (PLAN.md 7.2). `index` is the defaulted index (prepends _deleted, appends the primary key) because that is what the storage layer builds. `indexString` is the raw string; a `{ "threw": ... }` value means upstream threw for that input.

determinism.mathRandom: xorshift128 seeded with 0x5eed1e55, 1 draw per call
determinism.dateNow: frozen monotonic clock starting at 1700000000000, +1 ms per call

upstreamBehaviour.detail: The index array contains a non-string entry (a literal number). `getIndexMeta` treats each entry as a field path and calls a string method on it, so it throws before any schema lookup happens.

cases.rustExpectation: reject at schema/index validation with a typed error, not a panic

upstreamBehaviour.detail: A numeric or object-typed field is used in an index without declaring `minimum` and `maximum`. Those two numbers are what sizes the fixed-width digit budget, so there is no valid index string to produce and upstream dereferences the absent bounds instead of validating them.

cases.rustExpectation: reject at schema validation with a typed error naming the field

upstreamBehaviour.detail: An index names a field path the schema does not declare. Upstream raises RxDB error CI1 with the offending path in `parameters.fieldName`.

cases.rustExpectation: must be a typed CI1-equivalent error, never a panic
